tutorial.direction: First decide whether the **foundations build up or down**. The base rank is fixed when the game is dealt and all eight foundations start from it. **This choice cannot be changed.**
tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations. They build **in suit**, one rank at a time in the direction you chose, wrapping King round to Ace, thirteen cards each. 8 x 13 = 104 to win.
tutorial.braid: The twenty cards in the middle are the braid. **Only its tail is available**, and a foundation is its only destination.
tutorial.fields: The four slots around the braid are the braid fields. Playing one to a foundation **refills that slot from the braid's tail** — the only thing that consumes the braid.
tutorial.helpers: The eight helper slots can **only be filled from the waste**. They park cards that cannot reach a foundation, but a filled helper stays filled until it goes up.
tutorial.stock: The stock turns one card at a time to the waste. When it runs out you may **redeal twice**.
tutorial.controls: Buttons for drawing, hints, undo, and auto-complete.

hintReason.chooseDirection: Nothing can reach a foundation until the direction is fixed
hintReason.fromBraidField: Clearing a braid field advances the braid — it is the only way to consume it
hintReason.toFoundation: Sending this card up clears one card from the table
hintReason.toHelper: Park a card that cannot reach a foundation — but a filled helper does not come back
hintReason.draw: Nothing can move, so turn a card to widen your options
